observations.stageChain: exactly three DSparkBlock stages; stage zero alone owns main_proj/main_norm and stage two alone owns the final HC, norm, Markov, and confidence heads
observations.mainInput: captures after target layers 40/41/42 are HC-mean reduced and concatenated 40->41->42 at every target position; stage-zero main_proj/main_norm processes the complete prompt sequence, retaining its last 128 rows for each stage context, while the separate last row is only the frontier tap for starting the next draft
observations.contextKV: each stage derives target history directly as kv_norm(Wkv(main_x(t))), applies base-theta RoPE only to the 64-wide tail at absolute target position t, and in-place E4M3FN Q/DQ only to seven 64-wide non-RoPE groups; target history does not pass through candidate HC-pre or attention norm
observations.tokenShift: after target evaluates p, target logits provide pending y[p+1]; DSpark embeds [y[p+1], noise x4] at input positions p+1..p+5 and its five head rows propose p+2..p+6
observations.nonropeStorage: the pinned config selects dtype=fp8 and scale_fmt=ue8m0 while ModelArgs supplies the absent scale_dtype key's fp8 default; the pinned act_quant kernel applies 64-wide in-place E4M3FN Q/DQ with amax floor 1e-4, power-of-two ceil(amax/448) scale, clamp to +/-448, FP32 dequant multiply, and BF16 store
observations.rawCache: each stage owns an independent 512-wide ring already committed through p before a proposal view is formed; the view is that committed history plus five transient candidate rows, with no duplicate current-main row; every accepted target-verifier row appends in order and a rejected suffix rolls back
observations.officialVsAntirez: the official direct target-history KV path, token shift, and no-duplicate-frontier ownership are semantic authority; antirez mechanics that transform/reinsert only a frontier main row are explicitly not copied
observations.hyperConnection: four HC lanes; pre=sigmoid+eps, post=2*sigmoid, combination uses 20 alternating row/column Sinkhorn normalizations, and the final HC head is a sigmoid-weighted lane reduction

observations.headerValidation: GGUF v3 metadata, tensor directory, aligned/non-overlapping/in-bounds offsets, and structural file size only; oracle fixtures contain no payload bytes and complete SHA-256/payload identity remain with gguf-tools/ds4-expert-major.py verify --dspark-support

findings: confidence scheduling uses the first per-position sigmoid below threshold, not cumulative survival
greedy and caller-uniform sampled Markov drafts feed each selected token into the next proposal step
sampling acceptance is prefix-cumulative only after independent p/q draws; rejection uses the guarded p-q residual
post-layer capture averages the four HC lanes at production width 4096 without aliasing the source
layer, token, HC, and hidden axes remain distinct: ordered taps 40/41/42 expose both the frontier row and every row in the retained last-128 prompt history
non-degenerate HC and final-head vectors distinguish lane order, flattening, omitted normalization/output projection, and confidence input
stage zero concatenates exactly three target captures at every retained position before main_proj/main_norm and repeats pending y[p+1]/noise embeddings across four HC lanes at p+1..p+5
the synthetic topology requires three ordered stage-distinct transforms while preserving one immutable shared main_x
three stage-specific 128-by-512 rings use direct kv_norm(Wkv(main_x)), absolute-position RoPE on the 64-wide tail, and UE8M0-scaled E4M3FN Q/DQ on the 448-wide non-RoPE prefix

the proposal ring is already committed through p and adds only five transient candidate rows; accepted multi-row target-verifier prefixes commit atomically while rejection and zero-row rollback preserve prior storage
the pending target token is y[p+1], candidate inputs occupy p+1..p+5, and five DSpark head outputs propose p+2..p+6 rather than re-predicting y[p+1]
the final support GGUF v3 header contains exactly 81 descriptors split 26/24/31 across stages; real-file offsets and structural size are checked without reading payload bytes
